scenarios.prompt: A branching progression graph spends a resource and unlocks a capability atomically. Define stable tree/node identity.

criteria.identity: tree_id/revision, node_id and prerequisite graph are explicit.
criteria.transaction: Spend/unlock and refund/respec behavior are atomic and idempotent.
criteria.migration: Existing profiles have a revision/migration policy and unlocked effects remain owned by their systems.
